pricing.title: Pricing | Two simple plans, no percentage of sales
pricing.description: Two simple plans. Start free and pay {orderFee} per order, or go Pro for {pro} a month with no order fee.

hero.title: Two simple plans, switch any time
hero.lead: Start free and pay a few cents per order, or go Pro for a flat monthly price.

plans.heading: Plans
plans.freeActivation: Your store takes orders from day one. Make a first top-up from {topUpMin} within {days} days or when your first order arrives, whichever comes first, to keep seeing new orders and send campaigns.
plans.featureShared: AI credits shared across your whole account
plans.featureOrderEmail: Order confirmation email to every customer, under your store name
plans.fx: Amounts are approximate, converted at today's exchange rate, and may move slightly with it. You top up your wallet in Egyptian pounds.
plans.fxOutsideEgypt: Amounts are approximate, converted at today's exchange rate, and may move slightly with it. You top up your wallet by card in US dollars.

estimate.title: What would a month cost you?
estimate.desc: Move the slider to your monthly orders and compare both plans.
estimate.savingFree: You save {amount} a month on the free plan.
estimate.savingPro: You save {amount} a month on Pro.
estimate.breakEven: From about {orders} orders a month, Pro at {price} costs less than order fees.
estimate.note: Payment gateway fees, shipping, apps and extra packs are separate and aren't included here.

compare.title: Every feature, side by side
compare.desc: Both plans come with every store feature. They differ only in how you pay, and in your monthly AI credits and campaign emails.
compare.note: Amounts are approximate at today's exchange rate. Apps, extra packs, payment gateway fees and shipping are separate, and their cost is shown before you pay.

monthlyFee.label: Monthly fee

salesShare.label: Share of your sales

visits.label: Store visits
visits.desc: No traffic limit and no extra charge for busy days.

stores.label: Stores per account

switchPlan.label: Switch plans any time

templates.label: Ready-made templates

builder.label: Visual website builder

theme.label: Store design system

pages.label: Pages and blog

seo.label: SEO tools

languages.label: Arabic and English store

minOrder.label: Minimum order amount

productViews.label: Views per product

statements.label: Wallet and statements

dashboardApp.label: Dashboard on your phone

notifications.label: Notification inbox

signup.label: Sign-up

support.label: Support

extras.title: Everything you might pay, plainly
extras.desc: These come out of your store wallet, which you top up in Egyptian pounds.
extras.descOutsideEgypt: These come out of your store wallet, which you top up by card in US dollars.
extras.topUpBody: From {topUpMin} to {topUpMax}, paid in EGP. On the Free plan, make your first top-up within {days} days or when your first order arrives, whichever comes first, to keep seeing new orders and send campaigns.
extras.topUpBodyOutsideEgypt: From {topUpMin} to {topUpMax}, paid by card in USD. On the Free plan, make your first top-up within {days} days or when your first order arrives, whichever comes first, to keep seeing new orders and send campaigns.
extras.appsBody: Some apps have a small cost, shown in your dashboard before you turn them on. One is Order Notifications, which sends customer order emails. It's optional and set per store.
extras.emailsBody: You can buy more once your monthly allowance runs out. You see the price in your dashboard before you buy.
extras.creditsBody: You see the price in your dashboard before you buy. Credits you buy never expire.
extras.processingBody: If you connect your Paymob or Kashier account, the gateway charges its fees to you directly.
extras.shippingBody: Tallaby doesn't deliver. You pay your shipping company or riders directly.

faq.title: Pricing questions
faq.desc: Can't find your answer? <link>Message us on WhatsApp.</link>

items.q: What does an order cost on the free plan?
items.a: {orderFee} per created order, whatever its value. No monthly fee and no percentage.

items.q: Do both plans have the same features?
items.a: Yes. Every store feature is on both plans. Pro has no order fee, and comes with {proCredits} AI credits and more campaign emails a month.

items.q: Is the free plan completely free?
items.a: There's no subscription and no card to start, and your store takes orders from day one. Make a first top-up from {topUpMin} within {days} days or when your first order arrives, whichever comes first, to keep seeing new orders and send campaigns; then {orderFee} per order comes out of your wallet.
From about {breakEven} orders a month, the flat {pro} costs less than per-order fees. Pro also gives you {proCredits} AI credits.

items.q: Do my customers get order emails automatically?
items.a: Only with the Order Notifications app on. It's off by default, and you see its cost in your dashboard before you turn it on.
Each AI action, like preparing a product from photos or text, uses one credit. Credits are shared across your whole account, not per team member.

items.q: How do I top up my wallet from Egypt?
items.a: You choose a top-up from {topUpMin} to {topUpMax} and pay it in Egyptian pounds. You see the exact EGP amount before you pay.
